segments.name: Telemedicine and other services
segments.description: Provides telehealth and teleconsultation services to users through its MaNaDr platform across Singapore and the APAC region.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that it has two operating segments as follows: 1. Telemedicine and other services

segments.name: Sale of medicine and medical devices
segments.description: Sells medicines, health supplements and medical devices to customers through its MaNaShop and MaNaPharmacy businesses.
segments.evidence: 2. Sale of medicine and medical devices

revenueModel.text: Users pay the company for teleconsultation and other services and for medicines and products, with product revenue recognized on a gross basis for inventory it sells and on a net basis for online marketplace sales facilitated for vendors.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue from sale of these products is recognized on a net basis upon delivery of the medicines or products to the customers.
